audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions that Lilting Lullaby only works on enemies who already carry Dream Dust.
audit.why: This is the whole matchup. Her R does not sleep an arbitrary target - it makes enemies "with Dream Dust on them" become Drowsy and then fall asleep. Dream Dust comes from her passive, applied when she hits you with a skill. A Zac who has not been hit by a Lillia spell recently is immune to her ultimate. That single fact converts her level-6 spike from unavoidable into something you control by managing whether you are dusted before she presses R.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json (R "causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep")

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[0].text and mid both write her W as "Watch Out, Eep!" with a comma.
audit.why: Riot's name is "Watch Out! Eep!" - exclamation, not comma. The packet did not flag it; its only Lillia suspectName was "Let's Bounce", which is itself a false positive.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] advises "Build early health so her passive burn barely dents you".
audit.why: Exactly backwards. Dream-Laden Bough deals additional MAXIMUM HEALTH damage over time, so every point of health Zac stacks makes her passive hit him harder, not softer. Zac is the largest health pool she will ever burn. Health is still correct for the rest of his build, but it is not the answer to her passive and the entry should not sell it as one.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now states the burn scales with the health he stacks.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json (P "deal additional max Health damage over time")

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that only the outer edge of Blooming Blows deals true damage.
audit.why: Q does magic damage to nearby enemies and extra TRUE damage on the edge. For a melee tank whose entire plan is to sit on top of her, that is a free win: closing the gap moves you out of the true-damage band. It also means the resistances Zac buys are worth more the closer he stands, which is the opposite of the usual spacing instinct.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lillia.json (Q "dealing extra true damage on the edge")

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer gives Lilting Lullaby's cooldown.
audit.why: It is 150/130/110 - the longest ultimate cooldown of any champion in this slice, against Zac's 120/105/90. A dodged or wasted Lullaby at rank 1 concedes two and a half minutes, which is a far bigger window than the entry's "she stays ahead until your R comes online" implies.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t all tell Zac to "W the %HP ticks" in this matchup.
audit.why: Unstable Matter deals a percentage of the TARGET's maximum health. Lillia is a fragile skirmisher, so W is Zac's weakest damage source here - the reverse of the K'Sante case where the same templated sentence happens to be right. Both directions of this error come from the same boilerplate string being pasted across matchups without checking the enemy's health pool.
audit.corrected: W dropped from the trade pattern in tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zac.json (W "a percentage of their maximum health")

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Lillia as "he", "his" and "him" in 18 separate strings.
audit.why: Lillia is female. It is a presentation defect rather than a tactical one, but it appears in tldr, winCon, a phase why, five breakdown keys, tradeBad, three dontsFull triggers and seven report cards, so it reads as machine-generated on nearly every card in the matchup.
audit.corrected: All 18 strings re-pronouned. Every substitution is length-neutral or +1 character.

notes: Two errors here that the near-miss detector did not catch: her W is written "Watch Out, Eep!" (comma) in two content strings when Riot's name is "Watch Out! Eep!", and the full layer misgenders her as he/his/him in 18 strings. The detector's only Lillia flag was "Let's Bounce", a false positive. Also worth the user knowing: the "W the %HP ticks" clause in tradeGood/breakdown.trading is boilerplate repeated across Zac matchups regardless of the enemy - it is actively wrong into squishies (Lillia, Kennen, Lucian, Master Yi) and right into health-stackers (K'Sante, Maokai, Malphite). It is worth a global pass rather than nine local ones.
